_comment: Ids from owed-baseline.txt that the CURRENT golden no longer owes (moved to SKIP/FAIL, or
dropped from cells.json) — named here with an owner and a rationale so the loss is a decision,
not silence. replay.sh reads this file; an id it does not cover is RED. `cells` is a regex over
the cell id (same convention as accepted-differences.json's `cells` field).
Coverage GROWING (a new id owed that was not in the baseline) needs no entry here — it is
always allowed and just printed; only a SHRINK needs to be named.
Nothing has been dropped from the 1.5.5 golden since owed-baseline.txt was generated from
golden/1.5.5/ledger.tsv's PASS rows. The entries below are cells that have NEVER been owed:
each is a `needs_fixture` SKIP that carries an accepted-differences.json entry naming a
deliberate 1.6.0 improvement over 1.5.5, so recording it would produce a divergence the
improvement register cannot forgive without an owner decision (a usage/status class ->
kind=breaking) OR needs a capability the oracle may not build for itself (a pinned-mock verb,
a concurrent-window-roll driver). They are named here so the reason each is not recorded is
written down and owned, and so the entry is already in place the day the cell is baselined and
then re-loses its fixture. Two of the five dormant accepted-differences ids reviewed alongside
these carry NO cell to name and stay documented solely in accepted-differences.json: PR2-D5
(route.failover|fb|member-slow does not exist -- closing it needs a fallback-pool member
override in oracle-config.sh, a new cell, and a fresh 1.5.5 recording) and S-14 (no gemini
speech/TTS cell exists -- every llm cell is op=chat, and a speech leaf needs a fixture, a
pinned-mock speech verb, and the product's refusal-envelope decision).

accepted.rationale: needs a tool-use verb in the pinned mock; product decision on the six-dialect tool-use response shape. The cell declared a mock_control the mock resolves to no verb, and an unresolvable control is served as a healthy 200 — so the cell would have recorded the tool-less happy path while claiming to pin usageMetadata.toolUsePromptTokenCount. The control is removed and the cell stays needs_fixture (SKIP) until the mock can answer with the tool-use token term and the product decides what that answer looks like in each of the six dialects; inventing either here would put the oracle's own guess into the golden. Twin of accepted-differences.json 'G-1': that register would forgive `body` when the cell records, but the same recording also moves `effects.usage` (1.5.5 bills 190, 1.6.0 bills 222), which an improvement entry may not waive — so recording is blocked on the owner promoting G-1 to kind=breaking, a product decision, not silence here.

twin of accepted-differences.json 'M-1 refund reaches the cell the charge reached'. The cell exists and is the ONE cell M-1 is allowed to forgive, but it is needs_fixture (SKIP): recording it requires the recorder to drive a CONCURRENT window straddle — a request pinned to window M whose charge lands on a cell a concurrent admission has already rolled to M+1 — which is a harness/timing capability the pinned mock and driver do not provide, not a mock verb or an in-tree fixture. And the divergence it would produce is effects.usage (a failed straddling request keeps/refunds its flat fee), a class M-1's improvement entry may not waive, so recording also waits on the owner promoting M-1 to kind=breaking. Both blockers are out of the oracle's hands; the cell stays a named gap until a straddle driver exists AND the owner rules on the class.

twin of accepted-differences.json 'M-2 a mid-stream upstream failure is not billed as a completion'. The six diagonal cells (one per streaming backend) exist and carry mock_control {"stream-error": true}, but stay needs_fixture (SKIP): the pinned mock answers stream-error for the OpenAI-compatible arm (openai_chat_stream_error emits the inline `data: {"error":...}` chunk M-2 shape (1) names) but NOT for the terminal `finish_reason: "ERROR"` Cohere shape (2), so recording all six needs a mock verb the oracle may not add here. And when they record, 1.6.0 diverges from 1.5.5 on `status` and `effects.usage` (the failed stream stops being billed as a completion), classes M-2's body-only improvement entry may not waive; per M-2's own rationale the entry deliberately stays fail-closed (an UNACCEPTED divergence is RED) until the owner rescopes it — its `cells` regex still names the stale outcome token `mid-stream-error`, and widening it is the owner's call, never an auditor's. Named here so the SKIP is an owned decision while it waits on both.
